item.title: Melaka Votes: The Squeezed Generation with Neow Choo Seong | Poll Position
item.description:
Voters aged 40 and below make up 48% of Melaka's electorate. This episode features a look into the job and cost-of-living pressures facing young voters, why MCA says the unity government's reforms have yet to reach people's livelihoods, and the party's pitch to Chinese voters ahead of the 14 November polls.
